verdict.rationale: GitLab clearly supports self-hosting. Its docs describe several install paths: a Linux package (docs-9), official Docker images (docs-25), self-compiling when the package isn't available for a distribution (docs-26), Helm/Operator for cloud-native installs (docs-21), and recommended scaling configurations (docs-11). Nothing in the pack shows low-resource operation, support for non-Linux OSes, multiple CPU architectures, or a choice of database backends. Community commenters note running it in a TurnKey VM but recommend gogs for a much smaller footprint (comm-8). Missing for 10: evidence of low-resource or minimal hardware requirements, multi-OS support beyond Linux, multi-CPU-architecture builds, and support for multiple database backends.
